avoid_supplements.name: Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Colesevelam binds bile acids and reduces fat absorption, impairing absorption of fat-soluble vitamins
avoid_supplements.action: Supplement fat-soluble vitamins at least 4 hours before or after colesevelam dose; monitor vitamin levels annually

avoid_supplements.name: Digoxin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Colesevelam may bind digoxin in the GI tract, reducing its bioavailability and therapeutic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Administer digoxin at least 2 hours before colesevelam; monitor digoxin levels

avoid_supplements.name: Levothyroxine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Bile acid sequestrants can reduce thyroid hormone absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Take levothyroxine at least 4 hours before colesevelam; monitor TSH levels

avoid_supplements.name: Phosphate binders
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May have additive GI binding effects affecting mineral absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor phosphate levels

caution_supplements.name: Beta-carotene
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have reduced absorption due to impaired fat absorption
caution_supplements.action: Monitor vitamin A levels; consider supplementation if deficiency develops

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Increased GI binding may reduce absorption slightly
caution_supplements.action: Take at least 2 hours apart from colesevelam

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Colesevelam reduces fat absorption; high-fat intake may worsen GI side effects and nutrient malabsorption
avoid_foods.action: Maintain moderate fat intake; distribute fat intake evenly throughout the day

caution_foods.name: Vitamin K-rich foods (leafy greens, cruciferous vegetables)
caution_foods.mechanism: Colesevelam may reduce vitamin K absorption; dietary consistency important
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent intake of vitamin K-rich foods; monitor INR if on anticoagulants

caution_foods.name: Calcium-fortified foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May compete with colesevelam binding; timing separation recommended
caution_foods.action: Consume calcium-fortified foods at least 2 hours apart from colesevelam dose

caution_foods.name: Iron-fortified foods
caution_foods.action: Monitor for anemia; ensure adequate iron intake through diet or supplementation

monitoring_notes: Monitor fat-soluble vitamin levels (A, D, E, K) annually and counsel on adequate nutrient intake through diet or separate supplementation. Ensure all other medications are dosed at least 2-4 hours before or after colesevelam to prevent binding interactions.
